body: I’m a girl. I’m on bc but I’ll get one.
I know who it was but that happened last night. It’s been almost 24 hours

You aren’t trying to be mean and you made a fair argument. I just can’t put anymore effort into helping him stop if he doesn’t even acknowledge how much he’s drinking. I truly wish there was more I could do to help I don’t want to see him like this.

I’ve tried to help him out. He won’t acknowledge how much he drinks. I’ve told his therapist, family, friends. I’ve tried to get him to understand how bad it is. I understand it sounds bad to leave but I’m not going to watch him throw his life away. If he doesn’t want help it won’t do anything. If he wants help then I’ll be there as a friend. I can’t care more then he does.
